rationale: The core obstacle–vehicle situation requiring braking is supported by the hazard and requirements. However, the declared scope additionally includes the obstacle-detection/path-planning/controller context. These are supporting observation, computation and control mechanisms; their relevance to preventing omitted braking does not establish the broader mechanism context as part of P. Required braking behaviour itself is justified by T and FR-7.
determining_elements: “Obstacle presence and proximity can require a braking maneuver” identifies a supported condition relevant to T.
Obstacles or road users “on or close to the trajectory” are supported by H-1 and FR-7.2.4.

The scope’s inclusion of “the related obstacle-detection/path-planning/controller context” extends beyond the braking-required situation to supporting mechanisms without establishing their membership in the phenomenon.

SG-1 and FR-7 establish required braking as the relevant response, while the architecture establishes implementation relationships rather than justification for including the entire related mechanism context.
